name: Minerals 260 Limited
summary: Minerals 260 Limited is an Australian mineral exploration company, established in 2021 and based in West Perth. It plans to secure full ownership of the Moora project and holds an option over a majority share of the Koojan project, both prospecting for gold, nickel, copper and platinum group elements. It is also involved in the Dingo Rocks project and has applied for tenements in the Yalwest area.
